notes.title: Chinese, Polish & Small Fixes
notes.content:
Hello,

Thanks to the work of more awesome people, the game is now available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Polish!

I've also fixed some bugs and tweaked some things. You can see the full [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1144910/announcements/detail/3025824186760341357]changelog here[/url].

Cheers!

notes.title: Russian & Portuguese (BR)
notes.content:
Hello,

Thanks to the work of some players, the game is now available in 2 more languages: Portuguese (BR) and Russian.

If you also want to help bring the game into your own language, feel free to head out to [url=https://www.localizor.com/space-gladiators]Localizor[/url] and start translating!

I've also fixed some bugs. You can see the full [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1144910/announcements/detail/2909853324826734266]changelog here[/url].

Cheers!
